steps.text: Unknown state.
Talk to the Odd Old Man east of Varrock.
choices: Anything I can do to help?

steps.text: Kill a giant rat south east of Varrock.
Kill the unicorn south east of Varrock.
Kill the bear south east of Varrock.
Kill a ram south of Varrock.
Kill a goblin east of Lumbridge.
Kill a big frog in the Lumbridge Swamp.
Kill a monkey on Karamja.
Kill a giant bat in the Karamja Volcano Dungeon.
Kill a giant bat in the Karamja Volcano Dungeon.
Pickup the bone.
Talk to Fortunato in Draynor Village, and then buy 8 jugs of vinegar from him.
Use the vinegar on pots for 8 pots of vinegar.
Use the bones on the pots of vinegar.
Place logs under the pot-boiler near the Odd Old Man. If you've already polished all the bones, hand them in to the Odd Old Man.
Add a bone to the pot boiler.
Light the logs under the pot-boiler.
Wait for the bones to be cleaned. You can hop worlds to make this happen instantly.
Take the pot from the pot-boiler.
Give the Odd Old Man the bones.
Talk to the Odd Old Man to finish.
Repeat the steps until all the bones are cleaned.

combat: 8 low leveled monsters for their bones
